title: Jon Bowling Joins eXp Realty After 20 Years at RE/MAX
summary: Top Cincinnati real estate leader Jon Bowling moves his $90M team to eXp Realty after 20 years at RE/MAX. Learn what drove the strategic move.
body_markdown:
*Bowling brings his 17-person Mason, Ohio team to eXp, drawn by the relationships he built with eXp agents and leaders and a platform that lets him run his business his way.*


BELLINGHAM, Washington, November 10, 2026 — eXp Realty®, the most agent-centric™ real estate brokerage on the planet and the core subsidiary of AGNT, Inc. (Nasdaq: AGNT), today announced that Jon Bowling and Jon Bowling’s Team have joined eXp Realty after 20 years with RE/MAX.


Based in Mason, Ohio, the team includes 11 licensed agents and six support staff. It serves buyers and sellers across greater Cincinnati and closed approximately $90 million in sales volume in 2025.


“When a leader walks away from 20 years at one brand, it says everything about where the industry is headed,” said Leo Pareja, CEO of eXp Realty. “Jon built a $90 million business on great people and great service. Teams like his are exactly what our platform was built for. We bring the tools, the compliance and the community. He gets to run his business his way. We’re proud to welcome Jon and the entire team to eXp.”


Bowling’s move to eXp was built on relationships. Over the past two years, he got to know eXp agents and leaders across the country. What stood out was how freely they shared what was working and how willing they were to help him grow.


“The culture at eXp is open. People share. A rising tide lifts all boats,” said Bowling. “RE/MAX was a great vehicle to get us here. Now it’s time for something built for where we’re going. eXp is a business platform. They keep us compliant and we get to run our team the way we want to run it.”


Joining Bowling at eXp are team leaders Kimberly Ballinger and Brad Babiak, along with the full team of agents and support staff.


Bowling spent 20 years building his business at RE/MAX. Now he’s taking it to eXp, and heading into 2027 with momentum.


**About AGNT, Inc. (AGNT)**


Built by Agents. Built for Agents. AGNT, Inc. (Nasdaq: AGNT) is the global parent company of eXp Realty®, the most agent-centric™ real estate brokerage on the planet, NextHome, Inc., an award-winning national real estate franchise, FrameVR.io, a virtual collaboration platform, and SUCCESS® Enterprises, a leading personal development and media brand for entrepreneurs. Together, the AGNT platform provides a world-class multi-model operating system empowering independent agents, franchise owners, and team leaders across the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Asia Pacific, and South Africa. As a publicly traded company, AGNT prioritizes transparency, innovation, and long-term value for agents, franchise owners, staff, and shareholders.
